request: Add a settings page for a signed-in user. It needs somewhere to edit their display name and bio, a set of switches for which email notifications they receive, and a clearly separated area at the bottom for deleting their account.

expect.note: A new page plus three sections a review would name out loud (profile, notifications, danger zone). Fewer than 4 creates is under-decomposition — the defect AAQ-008 was written to fix.

operations.intent: A bordered card section letting the signed-in user edit their display name and bio and save changes; sits in the first band of the Settings page.

inputs.name: displayName
inputs.description: current display name to prefill the field

inputs.name: bio
inputs.description: current bio text to prefill the field

outputs.name: save
outputs.description: fired when the user submits changes

operations.intent: One row in the email-notification list showing a label and an on/off switch for a single notification type; used inside a Repeater in the Email Notification Preferences section.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: human readable name of the notification type

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: identifier of the notification type

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: whether this notification is currently on

outputs.name: toggled
outputs.description: fired when the user flips this switch

operations.intent: A band section listing the user's email notification switches, rendering one Notification Toggle Row per notification type from a static list of the app's notification types (e.g. comments, replies, product updates).

outputs.name: preferenceChanged
outputs.description: bubbles a single row's toggle change up so the page can persist it

operations.intent: A visually separated danger-zone band at the bottom of the Settings page, set apart with a warning tone, containing a confirmation flow (type-to-confirm or a two-step confirm dialog) before allowing account deletion.

outputs.name: deleteConfirmed
outputs.description: fired once the user has confirmed permanent account deletion

operations.intent: Signed-in user settings page. On mount, uses /Logic Components/Is user logged in? to gate access (redirect to sign-in if not logged in). Assembles bands in order: Profile Edit Form (bound to the current user's displayName/bio, wired to save), Email Notification Preferences (wired to preferenceChanged to persist), and Delete Account Section at the bottom, clearly separated, wired to deleteConfirmed to trigger account deletion and sign-out.
Register /Pages/Settings in the Page Router's routes alongside existing pages; startPage remains unchanged. This makes the new Settings page navigable.
Add a 'Settings' link/button that navigates to /Pages/Settings so a signed-in user can reach the new settings page from their profile card.

advisories.message: /Visual Components/Settings/Email Notification Preferences repeats over static rows carrying "label", "key", "enabled". Those field names are the contract: whichever component draws one row must expose Component Inputs with exactly those names, or the repeater will render identical rows.
